articles.body:
If you're looking for DTI codes , IGN's got you covered! In this article, you'll find a list of all the active and working codes that you can redeem for free rewards and bonuses in DTI, including outfits and accessories like hats, bags, and jewelry to use in this Roblox experience by the Dress to Impress Group.

While there is a Discord server for Dress to Impress, we've saved you the trouble of hunting for codes yourself and rounded them up here.

Here are all the active Dress to Impress codes and the free rewards you get for redeeming them:

All the codes above have been tested as working at the time of submission. However, codes with unknown expiry dates may stop working at any time. Spotted a new code we haven't included or tried one only to find it's expired? Let us know by reporting them here .

Follow the steps below to redeem Dress to Impress codes and claim free rewards in DTI:

Click on the handbag icon on the left-hand side of the screen.

Paste your code in the "Enter code here!" field.

Why is My Dress to Impress Code Not Working?

If the Dress to Impress code that you're trying to redeem is not working, it's likely due to one of two reasons:

The most common reason for a code not working is that it's expired. While we check codes often, they can sometimes expire before our next check.

It's also a good idea to double-check the code you're trying to redeem for any typos or hidden spaces before or after the code. We've included copy boxes above so that you can copy and paste the code directly into Dress to Impress to avoid typos.

The best way to obtain more codes is to bookmark this IGN Dress to Impress codes page. We update it every time a new code is released, and test and verify every code ourselves, so you know you've always got the most up-to-date and active codes.

Alternatively, new Dress to Impress codes are posted in the game's official Discord server, so make sure to join there if you'd prefer to get them directly from the source.

articles.title: Chronicles: Medieval Developer 'At Real Risk of Closing' Before Release as Funding 'No Longer in Place'
articles.summary: Chronicles: Medieval developer Raw Power Games posted a chilling warning on its social media pages, warning that the studio might close before it can launch the Early Access version of its medieval open-world action/strategy sandbox because funding for the team is "no longer in place."
articles.body:
Chronicles: Medieval developer Raw Power Games posted a chilling warning on its social media pages, warning that the studio might close before it can launch the Early Access version of its medieval open-world action/strategy sandbox because funding for the team is "no longer in place."

In a message on X (with a hat tip to Insider Gaming ), Raw Power laid out its unfortunate predicament: "Due to circumstances outside our control, the necessary funding behind Raw Power Games is no longer in place. Without it we can't keep building Chronicles: Medieval, and right now the studio is at real risk of closing. We're not going to sugarcoat. You deserve to hear it plainly, and directly from us.

"What makes it hurt is how close we are," the message continued. "Early Access is within reach. The world we've been building for years is finally starting to feel alive, and we have so much we've been thrilled to show you. Every day in the studio – in Copenhagen and remote – we've seen people put everything they have into this game, often far beyond what anyone asked of them. They are the ones carrying the heaviest weight right now, and we couldn't be prouder of them. We don't know yet how this ends. But in the spirit of our game we're not going down without a fight!"

Chronicles: Medieval's Tom Hardy-narrated announcement trailer drew a lot of interest, netting more than 2 million views on IGN's YouTube channel . It was revealed at Summer Game Fest 2025, and we have since previewed it not once but twice . In our most recent hands-on, we noted that it still felt pretty early at the time, but also said, "The scale and detail of the battles simultaneously is very impressive," and, "Being able to jump into a commander at ground level for more of a third-person action mode is really cool."

Raw Power Games told fans, "If you want to stand with us, keep Chronicles: Medieval on your wishlist and keep talking about it. It matters more right now than you might think. Thank you for believing in us. Thank you for believing in this game. We really hope you'll get to play the world we've been creating."

Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .

articles.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
articles.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
articles.body:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with several bonus items, which will be revealed later in the Fan Fest keynote - I will update this as they are shown. Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.
